close_reason: REQUIRETLS inbound propagation is a larger change tracked by stoa-2xeks.24 (still open). The review confirms the gap. Deferring fix to that issue rather than implementing here.
description: session.rs MAIL FROM handler validates has_requiretls_param() and rejects if \!is_tls, but the require_tls flag is never stored in SessionState::Mail or SessionState::Rcpt. At DATA time the relay envelope is built without require_tls=true. RFC 8689 §2: any forwarding MTA MUST propagate REQUIRETLS on onward delivery. As-is a submitting client's REQUIRETLS is silently dropped. Open stoa-2xeks.24 tracks the wiring task.
title: REQUIRETLS from inbound MAIL FROM not propagated to relay envelope
